title: 电商订单领域 UML 类图

nodes.text:
Order
---
- id: UUID
- userId: UUID
- status: OrderStatus
- total: Money
---
+ place(): void
+ pay(): Payment
+ cancel(): void

OrderItem
---
- id: UUID
- productId: UUID
- quantity: int
- unitPrice: Money
---
+ subtotal(): Money

Product
---
- id: UUID
- sku: String
- price: Money
---
+ changePrice(price: Money): void

Payment
---
- id: UUID
- orderId: UUID
- amount: Money
- status: PayStatus
---
+ capture(): void
+ refund(): void

«interface»
OrderRepository
---
+ save(order: Order): void
+ findById(id: UUID): Order
+ findByUser(userId: UUID): List<Order>

图例

实线箭头 = 关联
虚线箭头 = 依赖
空心三角 = 继承 / 实现
实心菱形 = 组合（整体端）
空心菱形 = 聚合（整体端）

Order 为聚合根：
OrderItem 与 Payment 的生命周期
由 Order 统一维护。

JpaOrderRepository
---
- entityManager: EntityManager
---
+ save(order: Order): void
+ findById(id: UUID): Order
